items.reasonEnglish: Prepare local mobile data and calling through an official foreign-customer process.
stepsEnglish: Open the official bilingual SIM Card Guide.
Review the available number and service-plan choices.
Prepare the accepted identity document and follow the official identity-verification steps.
Read the service terms and the Chinese-language agreement before signing.
Complete the activation test; do not treat the SIM as active until the test succeeds.

items.reasonEnglish: Prepare chats, calls, and life-service access through WeChat's official app.
stepsEnglish: Open the official WeChat English website.
Choose the official download option for your phone platform.
Register by following the current instructions shown in the official app.
Complete only the verification steps shown in the official app, and never share a verification code with Landi.

items.reasonEnglish: Open the Plan's verified China places and route handoffs in a local map app.
stepsEnglish: Open the official Amap mobile download page.
Choose the official iOS, Android, Google Play, or HarmonyOS option for your device.
Install Amap and use Landi links only as handoffs; opening a link does not start navigation or a ride.

items.reasonEnglish: Prepare one official mobile-payment option while retaining bank-card and cash alternatives.
stepsEnglish: Download and install Alipay through an official app distribution channel.
Register with a supported foreign or Chinese mobile number by following the in-app instructions.
Follow the app prompts to bind an eligible international bank card; the issuer may require verification.
Review the product page and service agreement for current card brands, limits, and fees.
Keep a bank card or RMB cash as a fallback; Landi does not verify or perform payment setup.
